name: dividr-mobile
description: Mobile (PWA) build of Dividr — reuses the desktop React UI under ../src via Vite aliases, driving a remote server backend.

comments.deps: The shared UI under ../src pulls in React + all of the desktop frontend's libraries (radix, zustand, remotion, wavesurfer, etc.). Vite resolves those from the repo-root node_modules, so run `npm install` (or yarn) at the repo root before building here. This package only declares the mobile build toolchain.
